messages:
aria: Heads-up — HelioHealth POC seeing intermittent streaming corruption from our Android SDK during staging demos. Truncated SSE events causing JSON parse failures. Demo scheduled tomorrow; need triage ASAP.

samir: Which SDK version and platform? Android native or webview?

aria: Android native SDK v0.9.3. Fail rate ~10-20% on their staging devices. Repro: start convo, wait ~12-40s, stream cuts mid-event and client attempts to parse partial JSON.

pria: Can you paste the client error and any server logs, plus the model/route?

aria: Client: "org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object at character 1023"
Route: POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b (standard)
Server log excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:11Z INF client=helio/staging conn=abcd1234 bytes_sent=6248
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end="\\n\\n"
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z WARN client_parse_error client=helio/staging err="partial chunk dropped"
```

josh: That last_event_len suggests the connection was flushed mid-event. Common causes: CDN/app-gateway flushes, MTU-sized writes, or socket keepalive behavior. Any intermediate proxies?

aria: Topology: mobile -> company NAT -> CloudFront-like CDN -> app gateway -> our edge. They tested direct-to-edge once; failures dropped but didn't disappear.

samir: Two parallel mitigations: client-side buffering + incremental UTF-8 decoding, and server-side safe framing. Client snippet (Android):
```
StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder();
String line;
while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
  buf.append(line).append("\\n");
  if (buf.toString().endsWith("\\n\\n")) {
    String event = buf.toString().trim();
    // parse event.payload as JSON
    buf.setLength(0);
  }
}
```

aria: Customer says they already buffer like this but still see invalid UTF-8 sequences (multi-byte boundaries split), breaking their decoder.

josh: Yep — split UTF-8 code points are a frequent culprit when proxies flush small frames. Quick low-risk options:
  1) Server: append an explicit sentinel event after logical output chunks so clients get complete JSON at safe boundaries.
  2) Client: use CharsetDecoder with incremental decoding to handle split codepoints.

priya: I'll open runtime ticket to add an optional sentinel flag for streaming routes and SDK ticket to harden Android decoding.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio]

samir: For immediate relief I can hot-toggle a per-routing-key flag send_fragment_sentinel=true which appends `event: fragment_end\\ndata: {\"last\":true}\\n\\n` after logical chunks. Low-risk and reversible. Also suggest route-level keepalive=15s to reduce proxy idle flushes.

aria: Asked customer for permission to toggle for helio-staging; they approved.

samir: Toggled send_fragment_sentinel at 2026-03-18T15:12Z for routing key helio-staging. Monitoring logs now.

aria: After toggle they ran 25 sessions direct-to-edge: zero parser exceptions. CDN path re-run shows failures dropped from ~1-in-8 to ~1-in-300. Customer rerunning full demo path.

priya: Follow-ups logged: INF-7243 (eng-runtime sentinel + admin UI), INF-7244 (eng-sdk Android incremental UTF-8), INF-7245 (eng-platform route keepalive override).

kendall-sales: I'll update HelioHealth: low-risk server toggle applied, SDK guidance provided, timeline for SDK/runtime improvements, and dedicated capacity pricing options if they want stronger SLAs. Note: dedicated helps node-level contention but won't fix CDN fragmentation.

aria: Closing loop with customer and scheduling a post-demo retrospective. Marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
